function EddUss(e: any) {
  e.preventDefault()
  if (!user) return
  const Editobj = {
    id: user.id,
    name: e.target.name.value,
    age: Number(e.target.age.value),
    image: image || user.image,
    status: e.target.status.value === "online",
    isCompleted: user.isCompleted,
  }
  e.target.reset()
  setImage("")
  dispatch(EditUser(Editobj))
  setUser(null)
}
